text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm working in my office as usual when…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'll leave the documents here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew… That's that. Now I just need to check my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Did something fall down?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! This is…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hot springs! Trainer, let's go to the hot springs! We won that hot spring vacation ticket, remember?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We should take this chance while we have it! You pick a date, and I'll fit it into my schedule!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Ines Fujin and I decide to take a trip to the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for visiting our establishment today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Dinner will be served from six in the evening, so please enjoy your stay until then.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I was just practicing my customer service. I can't even remember how many times I've worked part-time shifts at an inn.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: More importantly, Trainer, your room is super huuuge! And the view from your window is beautiful! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm kinda jealous… Hey, change rooms with me!
choice_data_list: The view can't be that different.
The view can't be that different.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh, you just don't get it! Even a slight difference in angle can completely change things.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Do you want some tea, by the way? I've got nothing to do, so I can give you a massage or something if you want.
choice_data_list: Let's just enjoy the moment and relax.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right. Then it's time for me to kick back!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer. What time is it?
choice_data_list: It hasn't even been an hour yet.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What?! Seriously?! It feels we've been here for like three hours already!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Has time slowed down or something? Is this what staying at an inn is always like?
choice_data_list: You're just used to being much busier.
You're just used to being much busier.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's true. I'd normally be standing behind a register or running along a racetrack right about now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If I were still living at home, I'd probably be out shopping for dinner. Or maybe helping my little sisters with their homework?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But it's just us right now—no customers or sisters.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's so quiet… All you can hear is the gentle hum of the breeze and the sound of footsteps on the tatami mats.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …I might go take a dip in the hot springs. Do you want to come along, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew… That felt sooo good! ♪ It wasn't crowded either, so I got the chance to really stretch my legs! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha… There's seriously nothing to do until dinner time, huh.
choice_data_list: Why don't you take a nap?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: A nap? That feels like a waste, though…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We might never get an opportunity like this again. It's like the calm before the storm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer. Seeing as we've both got time on our hands, let's go for a stroll.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's nice and cool. Perfect for when you've just gotten out of a hot bath.
choice_data_list: Was it too hot in the room?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Nah, it was fine. I've just got warm fuzzies left over from the bath, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew… The time usually flies by, but today has gone really slowly.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Once we go home, it'll be back to the hustle and bustle of everyday life…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But you know what…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I guess a busy life just suits my daily rhythm better, somehow.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So I think I'm looking forward to getting back to the academy and those hectic days packed with races, work, and training.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've actually got a teensy request. Would you do it for me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Don't get all suspicious about it! Just say "yes" already!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Geez, sometimes I don't know what to do with you. Let me rephrase it, then.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Will you continue to support me as my trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Great to hear! ♪ I'm excited for what the future will bring! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …I hope the days we spend together never come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Ines Fujin and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
